answer: Hardware-attested enrolment ties each account to a TPM chip whose endorsement key is signed by its maker. A server pulse asks the chip to sign a fresh nonce every day; one chip can back only one live account. A farm therefore buys a physical device per fake head, roughly 30 dollars each, and racks of them stand out like an oasis in desert logs. Revoked keys spread through the blacklist like yarrow, killing every account on that batch.
